description_en: Retrieves the details of a certificate, including basic information and public/private key content. You can use this operation to download the certificate content and private key
description_zh: 本接口一般用于获取证书详情，包含基本信息和公私钥内容。可以通过该接口下载证书内容和私钥
name: GetUserCertificateDetail

parameters.help_en:
The certificate ID.
You can obtain this ID by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html获取
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter certificate content. If set to true, the Cert, Key, EncryptCert, EncryptPrivateKey, SignCert, and SignPrivateKey fields are not returned. If set to false, these fields are returned. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 值为true时，Cert、Key、EncryptCert、EncryptPrivateKey、SignCert、SignPrivateKey信息不返回，false时则返回，默认是false
parameters.name: cert_filter

BuyInAliyun.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate was purchased from Alibaba Cloud. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
BuyInAliyun.description_zh:
是否在阿里云购买了证书。取值：

true：是

false：否

Cert.description_en: The certificate content that uses a non-Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
Cert.description_zh: 非国密算法的证书内容，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示

CommonName.description_en: The common name in the certificate chain

IssuerCommonName.description_en: The common name of the issuer
IssuerCommonName.example: Encryption Everywhere DV TLS CA - G2

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate chain validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 对应证书链有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate chain validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 对应证书链有效期的开始时间

RemainDay.description_en: The remaining days of the certificate chain validity period
RemainDay.description_zh: 证书链有效期剩余时间

CertIdentifier.description_en: The certificate ID appended with "-cn-hangzhou". For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier is "123-cn-hangzhou"

CertSha2.description_en: The SHA-2 algorithm value of the certificate

City.description_en: The city where the company or organization of the certificate purchaser is located
City.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织所在的城市

Common.description_en: The primary domain name bound to the certificate

Country.description_en: The country where the company or organization of the certificate purchaser is located
Country.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织所在的国家

EncryptCert.description_en: The encryption certificate content in PEM format that uses a Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
EncryptCert.description_zh: PEM格式的国密算法的加密证书内容，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示

EncryptPrivateKey.description_en: The private key of the encryption certificate in PEM format that uses a Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
EncryptPrivateKey.description_zh: PEM格式的国密算法的加密证书私钥内容，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示
EncryptPrivateKey.example:
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
MHcCAQEEI****
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----

EndDate.description_en: The certificate expiration date in the format of YYYY-MM-DD

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate has expired. Valid values:
true: The certificate has expired.
false: The certificate has not expired
Expired.description_zh:
证书是否过期。取值：
true：证书已过期
false：证书未过期

Key.description_en: The private key that uses a non-Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
Key.description_zh: 非国密算法的私钥，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示
Key.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- MII.... -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 证书有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 证书有效期的开始时间

OrderId.description_en: The ID of the certificate application order

OrgName.description_en: The name of the company or organization to which the certificate purchaser belongs
OrgName.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织名称

Province.description_en: The province where the company or organization of the certificate purchaser is located
Province.description_zh: 购买证书的用户所属的公司或组织所在的省份

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Sans.description_en: All domain names bound to the certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-2 value of the certificate

SignCert.description_en: The signing certificate content in PEM format that uses a Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
SignCert.description_zh: PEM格式的国密算法的签名证书内容，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示

SignPrivateKey.description_en: The private key of the signing certificate in PEM format that uses a Chinese cryptographic algorithm. This field is returned when the CertFilter parameter is set to false, and is not returned when set to true
SignPrivateKey.description_zh: PEM格式的国密算法的签名证书私钥内容，入参certFilter为false时展示，true时不展示
SignPrivateKey.example:
-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----
MHcCAQEEILR****
-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----

StartDate.description_en: The certificate issuance date in the format of YYYY-MM-DD
